description: This file contains utility functions for dumping native process information, including process filtering, HAL interface handling, and process identification based on command line and oom_score_adj. It is part of the dump utilities in an Android environment.

methods.name: read_extra_hals_to_dump_from_property
methods.description: Reads additional HAL interfaces to dump from system property 'ro.dump.hals.extra' and populates the set.

methods.name: should_dump_hal_interface
methods.description: Checks if a given HAL interface is in the default or extra dump list.

methods.name: should_dump_native_traces
methods.description: Determines if a process at a given path should be dumped based on predefined process lists and debuggable property.

methods.name: get_interesting_aidl_pids
methods.description: Retrieves PIDs of services matching specific AIDL interface prefixes.

methods.name: get_interesting_hidl_pids
methods.description: Retrieves PIDs of HAL services matching interfaces in the dump list.

methods.name: get_interesting_pids
methods.description: Combines HIDL and AIDL PIDs into a single set of interesting process IDs.

methods.name: IsZygote
methods.description: Checks if a process with a given PID is a Zygote process based on its command line.

methods.name: IsCached
methods.description: Checks if a process with a given PID is a cached process based on oom_score_adj value.
